title: Struct reinterpretation
prompt: Implement struct `Packet { public uint Header; public uint Payload; }` and `static uint[] ReadPacketBytes(byte[] bytes)` that reinterprets an 8-byte segment as a Packet via MemoryMarshal.Read<Packet> — returning [Header, Payload] as a uint array. The test feeds little-endian bytes and verifies field values; the lesson: reinterpretation is layout-dependent and never a substitute for a real parser.

tests.name: packet-fields
